title: ApplicationNativePage
description: Authorized ACTIVE binding's independent native page. Exact origin is release and deployment approved; no native credential or page body is returned.

preferences.description: DD-138: preference items the pinned APPROVED KAILO_EMBED release declares for Kailo settings (07 §4.8.2); the host sends their values to this page only. Absent when none.

adminSurface.description: DD-138(6): present only when the descriptor was requested for a declared admin surface after a fresh manage check (07 §4.8.5); url is then origin + the declared path and the host adds kailo_admin_surface=<key>.
